description: A faint, straight linear feature ~2–4 m wide with a distinct right‐angle bend visible in the LiDAR‐derived hillshade and curvature outputs. This lineament runs roughly NW–SE across the canopy‐covered terrace surface and is partially echoed as a pale line in the true-color image but shows no corresponding moisture anomaly in NIR (no dark‐earth signature). It does not align with any OpenStreetMap roads or clearings.
